name: Semester
source:
The game's story is about a transfer student, moved to another school. His name and his schedule will be decided by the player.

[From[url=http://www.renai.us/game/semester.shtml] Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:

[来自[url=http://www.renai.us/game/semester.shtml]仁爱档案[/url]]
